title: 美股盘前：芯片抛售拖累纳指，UNH与GS财报领涨；长债仍在5.18%上方
summary: 截至20:33 CST，道指期货约涨0.38%、标普500期货跌0.13%、纳指100期货跌0.59%；UNH、GS与Visa获明确正反馈，MU、SNDK及更广芯片链继续承压。

重大新闻汇总
地缘与能源
油价高位小幅回落但供应风险未消
Brent在亚洲早盘回落0.61美元至106.04美元；俄罗斯柴油增供预期与海湾供应、航运保险风险对冲。A/H油气上游仍有溢价，航空、化工下游与物流成本继续承压。 source
国内政策
发改委继续听取民企对三季度形势的反馈
国家发改委10月12日披露10月10日民营企业座谈会，覆盖石化、天然气、农机和AI应用；政策信号偏向稳预期和解决经营堵点，但不等于对单一行业的即时盈利承诺。 source
创新政策
新质生产力政策解读强调企业创新主体
发改委10月12日连续发布意见解读，继续强化AI、算力和产业创新，同时保留防止盲目投资与泡沫约束；A/H科技交易须以订单、盈利和价格反馈二次验证。 source
隔夜科技
微软AI芯片计划对冲科技板块回落
微软宣布新的AI芯片计划并突破4万亿美元市值，但纳指仍跌0.44%；A/H算力、服务器和先进封装仅获得情绪映射，不能外推为同步订单。 source
存储与半导体
美股存储链下挫，竞争与估值同时压制
Micron约跌3.9%、SanDisk约跌6%，市场重新评估中国存储扩产与高估值；A/H存储、设备和材料链可能分化，国产替代催化需与价格负反馈并列观察。 source
平台与广告
Meta反弹但科技广度仍弱
Meta因新模型与付费产品预期上涨逾3%，但科技板块整体承压、美国市场年度上涨仍高度集中；港股平台股需看开盘相对恒科表现。 source
亚洲风险
芯片抛售与高油价引发亚洲同步回撤
Reuters 09:41 CST显示MSCI亚太（日本除外）跌2%、KOSPI跌6%、日经跌2.6%；09:55 CST上证跌1.04%、创业板跌3.09%、恒科跌2.25%，隔夜风险已扩散至A/H开盘。 source
微导纳米
定增不超49.44亿元加码薄膜沉积设备
募集资金拟投无锡、华中半导体设备产业化、尖端薄膜沉积研发及补流；在手订单与半导体收入增长提供业务依据，但发行规模、审批、定价和稀释不可忽略。 source
奥克股份
重组终止，10月13日复牌
公司称短期实施条件不成熟，终止发行股份及现金购买资产并承诺至少一个月不再筹划重大重组；停牌前价格不能视作今日可成交价格。 source
新华传媒
十连板后停牌核查
9月21日至10月12日累计十个涨停、涨幅159.51%，公司提示股价严重偏离基本面并自10月13日起停牌；重组预期未消除估值与复牌回撤风险。 source
港股风险
十方控股更新审计与停牌进展
HKEX披露公司更新年度审计、财务状况和业务运营进展；审计延迟与持续停牌属于治理和流动性风险，不能包装成反转催化。 source

美股夜盘行情总结

收盘指数
10月12日道指+0.38%、标普500 -0.06%、纳指-0.44%；能源、防御板块强于芯片与可选消费。当前三大股指期货的可靠同一时点数值未取得，不用昨收替代。
商品与利率
Brent在10月13日亚洲早盘报106.04美元、较前值小幅回落；美国债市10月12日休市，10年期约5.24%沿用最近可得指示值并明确非当日成交。
A/H映射
亚洲芯片抛售与高油价形成共振；09:55 CST上证跌1.04%、创业板跌3.09%、恒指跌0.77%、恒科跌2.25%，A/H科技弱势已从风险提示升级为开盘确认。

盘前结论

09:55 CST上证跌1.04%、创业板跌3.09%、恒指跌0.77%、恒科跌2.25%，与KOSPI跌6%和日经跌2.6%的亚洲科技抛售同向，风险规避已获开盘确认。高油价仍支撑上游能源，但不足以对冲成长股和高估值题材的估值压力。

微导纳米定增后跌10.58%、奥克股份复牌跌9.91%，两项事件的负面价格反馈均已触发原先失效条件，相关个股维持回避。只有指数止跌、恒科相对强度修复且事件股抛压显著收敛，才考虑降低防御权重。

重点个股关注

微导纳米
A.688147
回避
事件：拟定增不超49.44亿元加码半导体薄膜沉积设备产业化、研发及补流；订单和收入增长仍是业务依据，但大额融资与稀释风险已进入价格。
最新反馈：10月13日09:56 CST报80.09元、跌10.58%，开盘84.53元后继续走弱，公告后的负面价格反馈明确。 source
解除条件：等待抛压收敛、股价重新跑赢半导体设备板块且融资定价和用途获得更清晰验证；在此之前不把扩产叙事包装成多头。
奥克股份
A.300082
回避
事件：因短期实施条件不成熟终止收购苏州祺添控制权及配套融资，10月13日复牌。
最新反馈：10月13日09:55 CST报7.73元、跌9.91%，复牌后真实价格发现为显著负面。 source
解除条件：需抛压显著收敛、股价重新站稳且公司给出可核验的替代增长路径；在此之前不把业绩改善包装成重组利好。
新华传媒
A.600825
回避
事件：连续十个交易日涨停、累计上涨159.51%，公司明确提示严重偏离基本面并自10月13日起停牌核查。
最新反馈：10月12日收13.78元、涨9.98%；停牌期间不存在可成交的盘前价格。
解除条件：等待核查完成、复牌后充分换手及重组审计评估和定价落地；在此之前高估值与快速回撤风险占主导。

板块轮动看板

油气上游Brent仍在106美元附近，地缘溢价延续；只利好具备真实产量和现金流的上游。
半导体设备亚洲芯片抛售扩散，微导纳米定增后跌10.58%；订单逻辑暂让位于估值与融资压力。
高估值题材A股宽度恶化、十连板停牌核查，短线拥挤交易风险上升。
航空/化工下游高油价压缩成本空间；仅油价持续回落并伴随价格传导改善才可能修复。

逻辑链

海湾供应与航运风险 → Brent维持106美元附近 → 油气上游获溢价、航空和化工下游利润承压。
美股存储链下跌 → AI硬件内部从普涨转向竞争与估值筛选 → A/H设备、存储和材料必须看订单与开盘反馈。
微导纳米大额定增 → 09:56 CST跌10.58%且弱于半导体设备链 → 原条件关注失效并转为回避。
新华传媒停牌核查、奥克股份重组终止复牌 → 事件驱动进入价格发现阶段 → 不以旧价或重组叙事替代风险确认。

风险雷达

油价与通胀Brent仍高于106美元附近，供应冲突或航运费继续上升将压制下游和估值。
亚洲风险共振KOSPI跌6%、日经跌2.6%，A/H成长指数同步走弱；区域去风险可能继续放大科技抛压。
公司事件微导纳米与奥克股份分别跌10.58%和9.91%，负面价格反馈已确认；新华传媒仍停牌，复牌回撤风险未释放。
数据时效AKShare为10月12日盘中快照；美股排行快照未覆盖10月12日现金时段，已降级为0行。

数据来源与时间点

增量证据截止2026-10-13 09:56 CST；首轮截止08:36 CST，新增1条实质增量并进入正文。AKShare仍为2026-10-12 13:59 CST快照：A股1215涨/4259跌、中位数-1.431%；港股675涨/1087跌/1048平、中位数0。Reuters于09:41 CST核验MSCI亚太（日本除外）-2%、KOSPI -6%、日经-2.6%。华盛通09:55-09:56 CST机器读取上证-1.04%、创业板-3.09%、恒指-0.77%、恒科-2.25%、微导纳米-10.58%、奥克股份-9.91%。当前三大美股期指可靠同一时点值未取得。国内公司事件来自公告正文镜像/交易所信息；GitHub Actions美股排行仅覆盖10月9日，今日不沿用。

Keyword Map

High oilWeak breadthPlacement downside confirmedMemory pullbackEnterprise innovationTrading reviewDeal terminationPlatform divergence
positivenegativeneutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not return.
Major News Roundup
Geopolitics & Energy
Oil eases slightly from elevated levels; supply risk persists
Brent slipped $0.61 to $106.04 in early Asia. Prospective Russian diesel supply is offset by Gulf disruption and shipping-insurance risk. Upstream A/H energy retains a premium while airlines, chemicals and logistics remain cost-sensitive. source
China Policy
NDRC continues private-sector consultation on Q3 conditions
NDRC disclosed an Oct. 10 symposium spanning petrochemicals, gas supply, farm machinery and AI applications. The signal supports expectations and operational problem-solving, not an immediate earnings promise for any one industry. source
Innovation Policy
New-quality productive-force guidance stresses enterprise-led innovation
NDRC released further interpretations on Oct. 12, reinforcing AI, computing and industrial innovation while retaining curbs on blind investment and bubbles. A/H tech still requires order, earnings and price confirmation. source
Overnight Tech
Microsoft AI-chip plan offsets a weak tech tape
Microsoft announced new AI-chip plans and crossed a $4tn market value, yet the Nasdaq fell 0.44%. A/H servers, computing and advanced packaging receive only a sentiment read-through, not proven synchronized orders. source
Memory & Semis
US memory shares slide on competition and valuation
Micron fell about 3.9% and SanDisk about 6% as investors reassessed Chinese capacity and rich valuations. A/H memory, equipment and materials may diverge; localization catalysts must be weighed against negative price feedback. source
Platforms & Ads
Meta rebounds while tech breadth stays narrow
Meta gained more than 3% on a new model and paid-product expectations, but the broader tech sector lagged and US year-to-date gains remain concentrated. Hong Kong platforms need opening relative-strength confirmation versus HSTECH. source
Asia Risk
Chip selloff and high oil trigger a synchronized Asian retreat
Reuters at 09:41 CST showed MSCI Asia ex-Japan down 2%, KOSPI down 6% and Nikkei down 2.6%. By 09:55 CST Shanghai was down 1.04%, ChiNext 3.09% and HSTECH 2.25%, confirming spillover into the A/H open. source
Leadmicro Nano
Up to RMB4.944bn placement funds thin-film equipment expansion
Proceeds target Wuxi and Central China semiconductor-equipment capacity, advanced deposition R&D and working capital. Orders and semiconductor-revenue growth provide business evidence, but approval, pricing and dilution remain material. source
Oxiranchem
Restructuring terminated; trading resumes Oct. 13
The company said near-term implementation conditions were not mature, ended the share-and-cash acquisition and pledged no major restructuring for at least one month. The pre-suspension price is not a current executable quote. source
Xinhua Media
Trading review after ten consecutive limit-ups
The stock logged ten limit-ups and a 159.51% gain from Sep. 21 to Oct. 12. The company said price had materially detached from fundamentals and suspended trading from Oct. 13; transaction hopes do not remove valuation and reopening risk. source
Hong Kong Risk
ShiFang updates audit and suspension progress
HKEX disclosed an update on the annual audit, financial position and operations. Delayed audited results and continued suspension are governance and liquidity risks, not a bullish turnaround catalyst. source

Overnight US Market

Cash close
On Oct. 12 the Dow rose 0.38%, S&P 500 slipped 0.06% and Nasdaq fell 0.44%. Energy and defensives outperformed chips and discretionary. Reliable same-time live readings for all three futures were unavailable, so cash closes are not presented as futures.
Commodities & rates
Brent traded at $106.04 in early Asia on Oct. 13, slightly off the prior level. The US bond market was closed Oct. 12; about 5.24% for the 10-year is explicitly the latest available indication, not an Oct. 12 trade.
A/H read-through
Asian chip selling is reinforcing the high-oil shock. At 09:55 CST Shanghai was down 1.04%, ChiNext 3.09%, Hang Seng 0.77% and HSTECH 2.25%, upgrading the A/H tech warning to an opening confirmation.

Pre-open Takeaway

At 09:55 CST Shanghai was down 1.04%, ChiNext 3.09%, Hang Seng 0.77% and HSTECH 2.25%, aligned with KOSPI down 6% and Nikkei down 2.6%; the Asian risk-off move is now confirmed at the A/H open.High oil still supports upstream energy, but not enough to offset valuation pressure on growth and crowded themes.

Leadmicro fell 10.58% after its placement and Oxiranchem dropped 9.91% on resumption, triggering the prior invalidation conditions; both remain Avoid.Only index stabilization, HSTECH relative-strength repair and materially softer event-stock selling would justify reducing the defensive stance.

Key Stock Watchlist

Leadmicro Nano
A.688147
Avoid
Event: an up-to-RMB4.944bn placement funds semiconductor-equipment capacity, R&D and working capital. Orders and revenue growth remain business evidence, but financing and dilution risk are now reflected in price.
Latest feedback: RMB80.09 at 09:56 CST on Oct. 13, down 10.58%; it opened at RMB84.53 and weakened further, a clear negative post-announcement response. source
Exit avoid only after selling pressure eases, the stock regains relative strength versus semi equipment, and financing pricing and use of proceeds gain clearer validation. Do not repackage expansion as bullish before then.
Oxiranchem
A.300082
Avoid
Event: the Suzhou Qitian control acquisition and related financing were terminated because near-term implementation conditions were not mature; trading resumes Oct. 13.
Latest feedback: RMB7.73 at 09:55 CST on Oct. 13, down 9.91%; genuine resumption price discovery is clearly negative. source
Exit avoid only after selling pressure eases materially, price stabilizes and the company provides a verifiable alternative growth path. Do not repackage improving operations as a deal catalyst before then.
Xinhua Media
A.600825
Avoid
Event: ten straight limit-ups produced a 159.51% gain; the company explicitly said price had materially detached from fundamentals and suspended trading from Oct. 13 for review.
Latest feedback: closed Oct. 12 at RMB13.78, +9.98%. There is no tradable pre-open price while suspended.
Exit avoid only after the review, full reopening price discovery, and completion of transaction audit, valuation and pricing. Until then, rich valuation and rapid drawdown risk dominate.

Sector Rotation Board

Upstream energyBrent near $106 preserves a geopolitical premium; only producers with real output and cash flow benefit directly.
Semiconductor equipmentAsian chip selling is spreading and Leadmicro fell 10.58% after its placement; orders temporarily yield to valuation and financing pressure.
High-valuation themesWeak A-share breadth and a ten-limit-up trading review raise crowding risk.
Airlines/chemical usersHigh oil compresses margins; repair needs sustained oil relief and better pass-through.

Logic Chain

Gulf supply and shipping risk → Brent near $106 → upstream energy premium, weaker airline and chemical-user margins.
US memory selloff → AI hardware shifts from broad gains to competition and valuation selection → A/H equipment, memory and materials require orders plus opening feedback.
Leadmicro placement → down 10.58% at 09:56 CST and weak versus semi equipment → the prior conditional watch is invalidated and moves to Avoid.
Xinhua suspension and Oxiranchem deal termination → event trades enter price discovery → stale quotes and deal narratives cannot replace risk confirmation.

Risk Radar

Oil and inflationBrent remains near $106; renewed supply conflict or shipping-cost escalation would pressure downstream margins and valuations.
Asian risk synchronizationKOSPI fell 6% and Nikkei 2.6% as A/H growth benchmarks weakened; regional de-risking can amplify tech selling.
Corporate eventsLeadmicro and Oxiranchem fell 10.58% and 9.91%, confirming negative price feedback; Xinhua remains suspended with reopening drawdown risk unresolved.
Data freshnessAKShare is an Oct. 12 intraday snapshot. US rankings do not cover the Oct. 12 cash session and are degraded to 0 rows.

Reliable same-time readings for all three US futures were unavailable. 芯片
CXMT进展触发第二日抛售
中国长鑫存储技术进展加剧供给和价格竞争担忧；NVDA跌1%、AMD跌1.5%、MRVL跌2.6%，MU跌3.2%。
存储
硬盘链跌幅扩大
WDC、STX与SNDK盘前下跌3.2%至4.8%，表明市场把冲击从DRAM外推至更广的数据存储估值。

UNH盈利与指引获强正反馈
UnitedHealth第三季盈利超预期、医疗成本率改善，并把2026年调整后EPS指引提高至至少20.50美元；盘前涨4.5%至395.50美元。
投行
GS依靠股票交易和投行收入超预期
Goldman Sachs投资银行费用同比增21%至32.2亿美元，股票交易推动季度超预期，盘前涨3.8%。
银行
盈利增长不等于股价上涨
JPM和WFC利润增长但盘前分别跌3.4%和1%；C虽EPS高于预期仍跌约0.5%，高利率下市场更关注交易、净息差和环比动能。
支付
Visa获准筹备中国境内清算业务
中国人民银行批准Visa开始筹备境内银行卡清算机构，结束多年监管等待；Visa盘前涨1.6%至395.42美元。
医药
JNJ超预期仍遭负反馈
Johnson & Johnson第三季利润略高于预期但盘前跌2.7%，说明高位估值与收入质量比单一EPS beat更重要。
宏观
油价与长债回落但仍高位
Brent跌约1.6%至104.62美元，10年期美债收益率降至约5.186%；成本压力缓和，但绝对水平仍限制成长估值。
日程
通胀与零售数据接棒
本周CPI、PPI与零售销售将检验油价传导和美联储路径；LSEG预计标普500第三季盈利同比增长30.6%。

盘前结论

事实：道指期货受UNH和GS支撑上涨，标普近乎持平，纳指100期货跌约0.6%；油价和长债回落，但全球芯片与存储链继续下跌。

判断：开盘基线是“防御与金融强、科技硬件弱”的分化交易。优先观察UNH、GS和Visa能否守住正反馈，避免对MU、SNDK、MRVL等下跌股逆势抄底。

不确定性：10年期收益率仍高于5.18%、Brent仍在104美元上方；银行财报后的价格反应和本周通胀数据可能快速改变板块轮动。

重点个股推荐

UnitedHealthUNH
盈利正反馈

推荐理由：第三季盈利超预期、医疗成本率优于市场预估并上调全年指引，盘前涨4.5%至395.50美元。

触发因素：开盘守住390美元并持续跑赢XLV，跳空不被快速回补。

风险点：医疗成本趋势、监管与指引兑现仍是核心风险；本轮未取得可靠带时标盘前成交量，不表述为放量。

Goldman SachsGS
财报强确认

推荐理由：股票交易与投行业务推动收入和利润明显超预期，投资银行费用同比增21%，盘前涨3.8%。

触发因素：开盘保持对KBE和其他大型银行的相对强势，并守住财报跳空一半以上。

风险点：交易收入波动、债券业务走弱和资本市场环境可能削弱后续动能；量能未获可靠带时标验证。

VisaV
监管催化

推荐理由：获中国人民银行批准开始筹备境内银行卡清算机构，盘前涨1.6%至395.42美元，处历史高位附近。

触发因素：开盘守住393美元并继续跑赢金融科技与支付同业。

风险点：这只是筹备批准，最终牌照、商业化时间与本地竞争仍不确定；本轮未取得可靠带时标盘前成交量。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

医疗保险、投资银行与支付出现明确公司级正反馈，UNH、GS和Visa是主要验证标的。

事件驱动

UNH上调指引、GS财报超预期、Visa中国清算筹备获批，以及本周CPI/PPI。

压力方向

存储、半导体与硬盘链连续第二日下跌；JPM、WFC、C、JNJ也显示财报后负反馈。

验证信号

纳指100能否收窄约0.6%跌幅、10年期能否留在5.20%下方、UNH/GS/V能否守住至少一半跳空。

逻辑链

新闻事实

CXMT技术进展加剧存储竞争；银行财报分化，UNH与Visa提供独立正催化。

资产反馈

纳指期货和芯片下跌，道指受医疗与GS支撑；油价与10年期收益率回落，黄金和比特币上行。

板块传导

资金从高估值硬件转向盈利确定性更强的医疗、金融和支付，财报质量必须由价格确认。

开盘判断

若芯片跌幅收窄、长债稳定，指数可维持窄幅分化；若MU与SNDK继续扩大跌幅，纳指压力将向软件和大盘扩散。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司：Kiplinger/Briefing.com的10月13日日历仅列AZZ为值得关注的盘后财报，AZZ属于金属镀层与基础设施而非科技公司；因此不虚构科技公司、一致预期、历史surprise或beat概率。

风险雷达

半导体竞争重估

CXMT进展已令韩国科技股暴跌并拖累美股芯片，供给与定价风险可能持续多日。

长债仍高于5%

10年期回落至5.186%仍处多年高位，高估值成长股对任何反弹都敏感。

银行财报反应分化

JPM、WFC与C的负反馈说明仅有盈利增长不足以满足高预期，净息差与环比动能更关键。

通胀数据风险

Brent仍高于104美元，本周CPI/PPI若显示能源传导，降温中的长债收益率可能重新上冲。

强势股跳空回落

UNH、GS和Visa均已盘前上涨；若开盘不能守住一半跳空，正反馈可信度将下降。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters截至美东06:54-08:00核验期指、芯片、银行、UNH、GS、油价与LSEG盈利预期；Barron's/FactSet核验道指、标普、VIX、10年期、黄金、比特币与Visa反馈；Kiplinger/Briefing.com核验10月13日盘后仅AZZ等非科技样本。内容于2026-10-13 20:33 CST（08:33 ET）复核；UNH、GS、Visa可靠带时标盘前量能不足，均已明确降级。

Premarket View

Facts: Dow futures rose with support from UNH and GS, S&P futures hovered near flat and Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 0.6%. Oil and yields eased, but global chip and storage shares extended losses.

View: The opening setup favors defense and financials over technology hardware. Watch whether UNH, GS and Visa preserve their positive reactions; avoid bottom-fishing MU, SNDK or MRVL while price feedback remains negative.

Uncertainty: The 10-year yield remains above 5.18% and Brent above $104. Post-earnings bank reactions and this week's inflation data can quickly reshape sector leadership.

Stock Picks

UnitedHealthUNH
Beat and raise

Rationale: Q3 earnings beat, the medical-cost ratio improved versus expectations and full-year guidance rose; shares gained 4.5% to $395.50 premarket.

Trigger: Hold $390 after the open, keep outperforming XLV and avoid a rapid gap fill.

Risk: Medical-cost trends, regulation and execution against guidance remain key risks; reliable timestamped premarket volume was unavailable, so this is not described as a volume breakout.

Goldman SachsGS
Strong earnings confirmation

Rationale: Equities trading and investment banking drove a clear revenue and profit beat; investment-banking fees rose 21% and shares gained 3.8% premarket.

Trigger: Maintain relative strength versus KBE and large-bank peers and preserve more than half the earnings gap.

Risk: Trading revenue is volatile, fixed-income activity was softer and capital-markets conditions may weaken follow-through; timestamped volume was not reliably verified.

VisaV
Regulatory catalyst

Rationale: PBOC approval to prepare a domestic bankcard-clearing institution lifted shares 1.6% to $395.42, near record territory.

Trigger: Hold $393 after the open and continue to outperform fintech and payment peers.

Risk: This is approval to prepare, not a final license; commercialization timing and local competition remain uncertain, and reliable timestamped premarket volume was unavailable.

Sector Rotation

Strength

Catalysts

UNH's raised outlook, GS's earnings beat, Visa's China approval and this week's CPI/PPI releases.

Pressure

Memory, semiconductors and disk-drive shares are down for a second day; JPM, WFC, C and JNJ also show negative post-earnings reactions.

Validation

Whether Nasdaq 100 futures narrow the roughly 0.6% decline, the 10-year stays below 5.20%, and UNH/GS/V retain at least half their gaps.

Logic Chain

News

CXMT advances intensify memory competition; bank earnings diverge while UNH and Visa provide independent positive catalysts.

Assets

Nasdaq futures and chips decline while healthcare and GS support the Dow; oil and the 10-year yield ease as gold and Bitcoin rise.

Sectors

Capital rotates from high-valuation hardware toward healthcare, financials and payments with stronger earnings visibility; price must confirm earnings quality.

Opening view

If chip losses narrow and yields stabilize, indexes may remain narrowly mixed; if MU and SNDK extend losses, Nasdaq pressure could spread to software and the broader market.

After-Close Earnings Beat Probability

Insufficient verifiable after-close technology earnings/no large technology company: the Kiplinger/Briefing.com October 13 calendar lists only AZZ as a noteworthy after-close report, and AZZ is a metal-coating and infrastructure company rather than technology. No technology company, consensus estimate, historical surprise or beat probability is fabricated.

Risk Radar

Semiconductor repricing

CXMT advances have already hit Korean technology shares and U.S. chips; supply and pricing risk may persist for several sessions.

10-year above 5%

The 10-year yield eased to 5.186% but remains at a multi-decade high, leaving expensive growth stocks sensitive to any rebound.

Divergent bank reactions

Negative reactions in JPM, WFC and C show profit growth alone is insufficient against high expectations; margins and sequential momentum matter.

Inflation-data risk

Brent remains above $104; if CPI or PPI shows energy pass-through, easing Treasury yields may reverse higher.

Gap-reversal risk

UNH, GS and Visa already carry premarket gains; failure to retain half the gap would weaken the positive signal.
